crossRefs.note: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.
Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped…
On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword…

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
translations.bsb: Some time later, Joseph’s brothers had gone to pasture their father’s flocks near Shechem.
translations.kjv: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
translations.asv: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
